label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) alert-TP: java.util.Random().nextFloat() generates weak pseudo-random values used directly as rememberMeKey, which is stored in cookies and session attributes as security-sensitive material. Alert 2 (xss) alert-FP: The XSS sink at L111-L116 echoes rememberMeKey value which is derived from Random(), not from user-provided input (param comes from cookie value but is never written to HTML output). Case TP driven by Alert 1.
